title: Budget
description: Cap this app's monthly egress and cost. You are alerted as usage climbs, and the app can be throttled or paused when the limit is reached. Counters reset on the first of each month (UTC).
loadError: Could not load this app's budget.

empty.title: No budget set
empty.body: Without a budget, heavy traffic can run up egress and cost with no warning. Set a limit to get alerts at 50, 80 and 100 percent.

usage.notPriced: No prices are configured, so cost reads zero and its ceiling cannot fire. Set prices on the Usage and cost page.

action.none: At 100 percent: alert only, the app keeps serving
action.throttle: At 100 percent: each client is limited to {{rps}} requests per second
action.pause: At 100 percent: the app is paused with a maintenance response

guard.alert: Deploys are never blocked by this budget
guard.block_deploys: At 100 percent: new deploys are refused until next month, a higher limit or a root override

form.egressHelp: HTTP response bytes served by ingress. Leave empty for no egress limit.
form.costHelp: Uses the prices on the Usage and cost page. Leave empty for no cost ceiling.
form.actionThrottleHelp: Limit each client to a number of requests per second. This slows heavy callers but is not a bandwidth cap.
form.actionPauseHelp: Serve a maintenance response until next month or until you raise the limit.
form.needLimit: Set an egress limit, a cost ceiling, or both.
form.badNumber: Enter a number of zero or more.
form.badThresholds: Use whole percents from 1 to 100, separated by commas.

remove.title: Remove this budget?
remove.description: The app is no longer limited or alerted on.

consequences.lift: Any throttle or pause in force is lifted.
consequences.history: The history of what happened is kept.

history.title: History
history.empty: Nothing has happened yet. Alerts, throttles, pauses and monthly resets are listed here.

toast.overridden: Deploys allowed for a short time

alert.label: Keep deploying
alert.help: Reaching the limit only alerts and applies the action above.

block_deploys.label: Block new deploys
block_deploys.help: Refuse new deploys at 100 percent. The running release keeps serving. A root user can override.

guard.blocked: New deploys of this app are refused until next month, until the limit is raised or until a root user allows them.
guard.overridden: Deploys are allowed until {{time}} by an override: {{reason}}

override.title: Allow deploys for a short time?
override.description: A root override lets new deploys through while the limit stays reached. It expires on its own.
override.audited: Your name and reason are recorded in the budget history.
override.expires: The override ends after a short window, then the guard applies again.

preview.title: What a pause would do
preview.description: A preview of stopping every app in scope until the month ends. Nothing is changed.
preview.total: {{replicas}} replicas would stop, saving about {{value}} over the remaining {{days}} days.
preview.noChanges: A real pause is not available yet. This preview changes nothing.

alertRule.name: Spend cap alerts
alertRule.created: Alert rule created. Attach a notification channel to receive it.

project.title: Spend
project.description: A monthly cost cap for every app in this project, with a projection and an optional deploy guard.

empty.title: No spend cap on this project
empty.body: Set a monthly amount to get alerts as the project spends and, if you choose, block new deploys at the limit.
